comments.author: Tozen
comments.story: What Makes the Zig Programming Language Unique?
comments.why: Evidence Blow popularized compile-time execution before Zig.
comments.text: > Zig's use of comptime is fairly revolutionary in a c-like language Not revolutionary. Before Zig came out, which was 2016, there was Jonathan Blow talking about and arguably repopularizing it. Lots of people (who knows how many developers) and languages were influenced by him too. 2014, Jonathan Blow, who made lots of videos and gave lots of talks, before going on to officially promote Jai (2016). And it appears he was playing around with prototypes much earlier and talking about it (from 2014). [VIDEO] (Demo: Base language, compile-time execution)
